name: freshman-admin-control
description: Standalone Freshman Admin Control Application & Android APK (edu.freshmanacademy.admin)

scripts.cap:sync: vite build --config vite.config.ts && npx cap sync android
scripts.cap:copy: vite build --config vite.config.ts && npx cap copy android
scripts.android:apk:debug: vite build --config vite.config.ts && npx cap copy android && chmod +x ./android/gradlew && ./android/gradlew -p android assembleDebug
scripts.android:apk:release: vite build --config vite.config.ts && npx cap copy android && chmod +x ./android/gradlew && ./android/gradlew -p android assembleRelease
